risk.noTests: Changed code path has no direct test coverage in the brief; verify behavior manually or ask for coverage.
risk.noTypes: Changed code lacks useful type coverage; verify runtime safety and narrowing at the boundary.
risk.legacyArea: Chunk touches legacy-marked code; verify the change follows current patterns rather than entrenching the old one.
risk.denseLogic: Chunk contains branching or state-heavy logic; enumerate edge cases before signing off.
risk.touchesAuth: Authentication, authorization, session, or identity behavior changed; verify access boundaries explicitly.
risk.mutatesState: Chunk writes or invalidates persistent state; check ordering, idempotency, and rollback behavior.
risk.removesValidation: A guard or validation boundary changed; verify the newly accepted input space is intentional.
risk.relaxesPermissions: Permission scope may be broader; enumerate newly admitted actors and confirm intent.
risk.widensErrorHandling: Error handling became broader or quieter; verify correctness bugs cannot be hidden.
risk.addsFeatureFlag: Feature-flag behavior changed; check defaults, rollout plan, and cleanup obligation.
risk.newDependency: A new direct dependency entered a manifest; verify it earns its place — stdlib or an existing dep may cover it.
risk.newAbstraction: A new named abstraction was introduced; check whether an existing pattern or utility already covers it.
risk.commentContradictsCode: A comment and its adjacent code appear to disagree; read both and resolve which side is right.
risk.externalIo: Chunk reaches outside the process; verify timeout, retry, idempotency, and outage behavior.
risk.crossService: Chunk touches a contract consumed outside this app; check compatibility and migration expectations.
risk.schemaAdjacent: Chunk sits near persistence/schema assumptions; verify consistency with the data model.
risk.hotPath: Chunk lives on a high-traffic or latency-sensitive path; check allocations, sync I/O, and unbounded work.
risk.widelyImported: Changed API has broad call-site reach; enumerate consumers and contract impact.
risk.releaseImminent: Change appears close to release; verify revert and mitigation paths are clear.

deleteModal.heading: Delete briefs for #{{number}} {{repo}}?
deleteModal.goes_one: Every brief for this pull request goes, and with it every reviewer's review session, draft comments and flag decisions.
deleteModal.goes_other: Every brief for these pull requests goes, and with it every reviewer's review session, draft comments and flag decisions.
deleteModal.next_one: The next push makes a new brief; the comment on GitHub stays.
deleteModal.next_other: The next push makes a new brief; the comments on GitHub stay.

purgeModal.heading: Delete the attachment branch of {{repo}}?
purgeModal.consequence: Every image attached from MergeBrief to a comment on this repository lives on its mergebrief/attachments branch. Deleting the branch breaks those images in every comment that embeds one, on GitHub and in every brief here.
purgeModal.irreversible: This cannot be undone. The next attachment creates the branch again, empty.

empty.heading: Nothing to review yet
empty.detail: Paste a pull request URL below to get its brief. Pull requests from repositories where MergeBrief is installed show up here on their own.
empty.filteredHeading: No pull requests match these filters
empty.filteredDefaultStatus: Merged and closed pull requests are hidden by default.
empty.allArchivedDetail: An archived pull request comes back on its own when a new brief lands.

noInstallation.line: MergeBrief is installed on no repository you can reach.

failed.heading: Briefs could not be loaded
failed.github: GitHub did not answer. Your rows are untouched; try again in a moment.
failed.server: The server did not answer. Try again in a moment.

signedOut.heading: Understand a pull request before you review it
signedOut.copy: MergeBrief reads the diff and hands you a brief: the changes grouped by what they are for, the places that deserve a closer look, and a receipt of what you checked.
signedOut.pictureAlt: A brief open in MergeBrief: a change-group with its risk surface on the left and the list of change-groups for the pull request on the right

shortcuts.cursorDown: Move the cursor down the list
shortcuts.toggleSelect: Select or deselect the row under the cursor
shortcuts.cursorUp: Move the cursor up the list
shortcuts.openRow: Open the brief under the cursor
shortcuts.closeMenu: Close a menu or this list
